subject: general
question: Where is Orang Tiger reserve located in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Orang Tiger reserve** is a national park located on the Northern Bank of the Bramhaputra River in **Assam**.
 
• In **Darrang** and **Sonitpur** districts of Assam.
 
• Covers an area of **79.28km² **(30.61 sq. mi).
 
• Established as a sanctuary in the year **1985** and declared a national park on **13th of April 1999**. 
 
• It is the only stronghold of the **Rhinoceros** on the north bank of the Bramhaputra river with rich flaura and fauna.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Assam** is a state in northeastern India known for its wildlife, archeological sites and tea plantations.
 
• The 15th Chief Minister of Assam is **Sri Himanta Biswa Sarma**.
 
• The 30th Governor of Assam is **Prof Jagdish Mukhi** and he assumed his office on 10th October 2017. 
 
• **Dispur** is the capital of Assam.
